title: Congolese army 'retakes strategic city of Uvira' after M23 withdrawal
summary: The Congolese army said Monday it had regained control of the strategic eastern city of Uvira after Rwanda-backed M23 fighters withdrew, following days of shifting troop movements. The pullout ends weeks of rebel presence in the lakeside city near the Burundi border, seized during an M23 offensive in South Kivu province.
